thread:
Daria H.: Quick share: ran pinwheel-11b v2 on the long-assist slice. fp16 vs int6 compare below, thinking about routing.
Ethan Q.: drop the headline numbers pls.
Daria H.: slice=long-assist-900 (avg 860 tokens). fp16 Rouge-L=42.7 / BERTScore=0.889. int6 Rouge-L=40.1 / BERTScore=0.874. p95 latency fp16=760ms -> int6=460ms. throughput +2.0x. cost/1k tokens fp16=$0.058, int6=$0.034.
Marta L.: hallucination and failure modes?
Daria H.: auto-eval n=700: int6 mean Rouge-L drop = 2.6 pts (sd 1.0). Hallucination flagged 11/700 (1.57%) vs fp16 2/700 (0.29%). Failures concentrated in multi-step contract-explain and billing dispute threads >1000 tokens.
Sam R.: Product: cannot take >0.5% hallucination on contract/billing. For other intents acceptable if we keep monitoring.
Daria H.: Econ rough: site tokens/month ~160M. If we route 30% to int6 infra raw saves ~= $6.94k/mo. Estimated added support/escalation cost at observed error rates ~$3.1k/mo. Net ~$3.8k/mo.
Ethan Q.: Routing idea?
Daria H.: Proto routing + holdback:
```yaml
route: long-assist
rules:
  - if intent in [contract_explain, billing_dispute] then model: pinwheel-11b-fp16
  - elif last_user_tokens > 300 or thread_turns > 7 then model: pinwheel-11b-fp16
  - elif model_confidence < 0.6 then model: pinwheel-11b-fp16
  - else model: pinwheel-11b-int6
fallback: pinwheel-11b-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate_by_intent, cost_delta
```
Marta L.: Suggest adding a cheap edge estimator (tokenized overlap with contract keywords OR presence of attachments) to reduce false negatives. Also 2% fp16 holdback for drift.
eval-bot: Live holdback sampling (n=200) -> int6 mean Rouge-L drop=2.4 (sd 0.9). hallucination flagged 4/200; manual review confirmed 3/200.
Daria H.: Canary plan: 72h 5% non-sensitive -> ramp to 30% over 10d with 2% fp16 holdback. Rollback triggers: hallucination_rate > 1% for sensitive intents over 6h OR rouge_l drop > 2.2 sustained 12h.
Sam R.: Please add a compliance signoff step before enabling for contract_explain. Also dashboard hooks for per-intent $ impact.
Ethan Q.: I'll wire feature flag + dashboards (rouge trend, hallucination by intent, cost delta). ETA 48h.
Daria H.: I'll post GTN README + eval notebook + cost sheet. Link after canary starts. :rocket:
